status: development design informed by inspected v3-v11 results; not preregistration or independent confirmation
inputs: Two unchanged strong scores T/uHNDI plus all six fixed local-contrast scores from v10 and every spatial/conditional profile from v11. No selection by outer outcomes. All same-input classical methods receive precisely this full matrix.
anchor: Binder/Wielek: raw T; Mendeley: original uHNDI. Disclosed developmental fixed choice from v11, not an improvement attributed to extra information.
algorithm: Training-only robust median/IQR with std/1 fallback; asinh strong scores; tanh extra features; least-squares projection on [1,asinh(T),asinh(uHNDI)]; tanh residual to bound each coordinate. At each of at most two steps choose the largest absolute negative pair-loss gradient minus one delete-patient sensitivity estimate, then optimize a signed scalar coefficient by convex all-positive-negative-pair logistic loss with fixed ridge and fixed per-step budget. No Gaussian downweighting of severely misordered training pairs. Total correction magnitude at most eta.
sensitivity: Delete every positive/negative patient from pair averaging while holding the training representation and current score fixed. sqrt((n-1)/n * sum((gradient_deleted-mean_deleted)^2)); this is a sensitivity penalty, not cross-validation, full-refit jackknife, calibrated confidence bound, or a significance test. No independent-pair assumption is used to treat pairs as patient sample size.
direction: Gradient sign learned exclusively from training labels, never test labels. Choose first input column on exact utility tie; no repeated coordinate. Utility<=1e-12 falls back to anchor. Coefficient nonnegative along the learned direction; choose zero/optimized/cap minimum with zero preferred on loss ties.
ablations: no_sensitivity sets penalty0; no_residual omits projection; local_only uses six v10 extras; profile_only uses v11 extras; correction_only outputs no anchor but retains declared baseline-conditioned representation. No independence-from-baselines claim.
selection: Mean three-inner-fold AUC; ties within1e-12 prefer eta0 then smaller eta then fewer steps. Seven configs identical for each primary/ablation across cohorts. No post-hoc outer seed/sign/channel exclusion.
inner_seed_rule: outer seed+10000+outer fold, exactly previous patient identities and splits
metric: Arithmetic mean outer-fold AUC, then five-seed mean and equal-cohort macro; retain all adverse results
performance_target: Positive macro delta over both raw T and original uHNDI at every seed, positive five-seed mean delta over both in every cohort, positive mean macro delta over measurement_anchor, local_only_increment and profile_only_increment. Same-input recent journal comparison required before algorithm-superiority claim.
novelty_limit: A candidate combination of patient-sensitive sparse selection and bounded strong-anchor correction; no constituent novelty, assured AUC gain, statistical significance, end-to-end raw-gain invariance or clinical superiority claim. Since absolute T enters projection, ratio extras do not confer whole-model gain invariance.
protection: All completed v3-v11 sources/results and original manuscript byte-protected. Freeze protocol/code before outer predictions; new version required for outcome-informed correction. Recent v10 journal comparison has different inputs and cannot establish v12 superiority.
